units.*_s: seconds of wall time inside the container (perf_counter), models resident, cold start excluded
units.*_m / *_mm / *_m2: estimated: floor plane + an assumed 1.6 m camera height; never measured
units.*_deg: degrees; tilt = deviation from plumb (vertical surfaces) or level (horizontal), relative to the coarse floor normal
units.ci95_deg: 2.5-97.5 percentile of 200 bootstrap least-squares fits over the RANSAC inliers (point noise only; the floor normal's error is not in it)
units.*_gib / peak_gb: GiB (2^30 bytes), whole device (nvidia-smi, every process incl. vLLM), per stage window; over_90 flags > 90 %
units.photometric_l1: held-out crop pixels -> 3D through the predicted depth -> nearest chosen view; mean |colour difference| 0..255
units.outline_iou: held-out crop: SAM 3 mask (observed) vs the object's points from the other views projected (fine) or the coarse spot points (coarse)
